kpi_definitions.On-Time Delivery Rate (%): Eligible shipments with actual shipping duration <= scheduled shipping duration / all eligible shipments * 100.
kpi_definitions.Average Delivery Delay (Days): Mean of positive delivery gaps among delayed eligible shipments. Early and on-time shipments are excluded from this average.
kpi_definitions.Late Delivery Risk Ratio: Eligible records with valid Late_delivery_risk = 1 / eligible records with valid binary Late_delivery_risk values * 100.
kpi_definitions.Shipping Mode Efficiency Index: For each shipping mode: 50% SLA compliance + 30% inverse late-risk score + 20% relative delay-gap score. Each component is on a 0-100 scale. Relative delay-gap score is inversely scaled across modes.
kpi_definitions.Regional Delay Index: For each region: average positive delivery gap / highest regional average positive delivery gap * 100. Regions with no delayed shipments receive 0. The highest-delay region receives 100.

invalid_record_treatment: Missing or negative actual/scheduled durations are excluded. Invalid late-risk labels are excluded only from late-risk calculations. Missing shipping mode or region values are excluded only from their respective breakdowns.
same_day_treatment: Valid zero scheduled duration records are retained.
dashboard_parity: A shared calculation module is generated for both notebook and dashboard use. Dashboard must import and call this module after applying equivalent filters.
